subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw publish these three specialized transcript writer-lock reads as stable Plugin SDK surface, or keep the optimization owner-specific until a broader plugin use case exists?
rationale: The patch is not only an internal query optimization: it expands the documented Plugin SDK contract, and repository policy treats new plugin APIs as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Sponsor the three methods as the supported plugin seam, then require the child to be restacked and re-proven at its exact head before merge.

options.title: Keep the optimization internal
options.body: Avoid extending the Plugin SDK and redesign the Codex/Copilot optimization behind an owner-specific internal boundary until external plugin demand is established.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor the three methods as the supported plugin seam, then require the child to be restacked and re-proven at its exact head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active stacked implementation chain and can provide the design rationale and exact-head validation for maintainer review.
